name: warrant
description: Work-unit protocol: one approval gate at the front, then uninterrupted execution. A proposal states the request, the constraints, and the write set; approval freezes that set; a PreToolUse gate refuses edits outside it and commits without the Proposal: trailer; SessionStart rebuilds the state from disk so an interrupted unit survives the session. Hunt dispatch is diff-size-proportional and bounded, with an adaptive-miss-streak budget, mirroring scout's bounded protocol.
